blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACEN Corp. has pursued the sale of its 49 percent stake in an Indian solar firm and has completed part of the deal with Dutch investor Diamond India Renewables One B.V. (Diro). In a regulatory filing, the Ayala-led renewable energy developer said it had completed the sale of an initial 10 percent voting interest in Tejorupa Renewables India Project Private Ltd. to Diro. READ: ACEN unit sells 49% stake in India solar project Tejorupa Renewables is the company leading the construction of a 250-megawatt alternating current solar project in Rajasthan, India.
